summary: Apple Hospitality REIT filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) to amend its existing equity distribution agreement (ATM program) for up to $500 million of common shares. The amendment adds Huntington Securities as a sales agent and removes B. Riley, SMBC Nikko, and Scotia Capital. The last sale price was $16.55 per share on August 5, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown/ATM program update, not a special situation. The filing merely updates agent roster and confirms remaining capacity under the existing at-the-market offering program. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, or restructuring elements are present. Watch for share issuance activity under the ATM, which could create modest overhang, but no special-situation catalyst is disclosed.
